units.en: Transcendent was his immortal talent, soaring and ethereal; a thousand fathoms and ten thousand acres—none could measure his bounds.
units.literal: Transcendent was his immortal talent, soaring and ethereal; a thousand fathoms and ten thousand acres—none could measure his bounds.

units.zh: 寡人欽承道風，久餐德素，頻遣使乎，遠此延屈，冀得虔受上法，式建良緣。
units.en: I have long admired his Way-wind and nourished myself on his pure virtue, repeatedly sending envoys to invite him from afar, hoping to receive the higher Law devoutly and establish a fine bond.
units.literal: I have long admired his Way-wind and nourished myself on his pure virtue, repeatedly sending envoys to invite him from afar, hoping to receive the higher Law devoutly and establish a fine bond.

units.zh: 至止甫爾，未淹旬日，厭塵羽化，反真靈府。
units.en: He had just arrived and not yet passed ten days when, weary of the dust, he transformed by feather and returned to the numinous realm.
units.literal: He had just arrived and not yet passed ten days when, weary of the dust, he transformed by feather and returned to the numinous realm.

units.zh: 身體柔軟，顏色不變，經方所謂屍解地仙者哉。
units.en: His body was soft and his complexion unchanged—is this not what the scriptures call a corpse-dissolving earthly immortal?
units.literal: His body was soft and his complexion unchanged—is this not what the scriptures call a corpse-dissolving earthly immortal?

units.zh: 誠復師禮未申，而心許有在，雖忘怛化，猶愴於懷。
units.en: Truly the rites of master and disciple were not yet performed, yet a promise of the heart remained; though he forgot sorrow in transformation, grief still lodges in my breast.
units.literal: Truly the rites of master and disciple were not yet performed, yet a promise of the heart remained; though he forgot sorrow in transformation, grief still lodges in my breast.

units.zh: 喪事所資，隨須供給。
units.en: Whatever the funeral requires shall be supplied as needed.
units.literal: Whatever the funeral requires shall be supplied as needed.

units.zh: 霓裳羽蓋，既且騰雲；
units.en: Rainbow robes and feathered canopies have already risen on clouds;
units.literal: Rainbow robes and feathered canopies have already risen on clouds;

units.zh: 空槨餘衣，詎藉墳壟？
units.en: an empty coffin and leftover garments—why rely on mound and tomb?
units.literal: an empty coffin and leftover garments—why rely on mound and tomb?

units.zh: 但杖舄在爾，可同俗法。
units.en: Only the staff and shoes remain with you; you may follow the common custom.
units.literal: Only the staff and shoes remain with you; you may follow the common custom.

units.zh: 宜遣使人，送還天台定葬。」
units.en: You should send envoys to return him to Mount Tiantai for burial.'
units.literal: You should send envoys to return him to Mount Tiantai for burial.'

units.zh: 周文東至崤、陜，遣其行臺侯莫陳崇自齊子嶺趣軹關，儀同楊檦從鼓鐘道出建州，陷孤公戍。
units.en: Yuwen Tai marched east to Xiao and Shan, sending field headquarters Houmochen Chong from Qizi Ridge against Zhiguan Pass while yitong Yang Piao by the Guchong road into Jian Province captured the Gugong garrison.
units.literal: Zhou Wen marched east to Xiao and Shan, dispatching his field headquarters Houmochen Chong from Qizi Ridge toward Zhiguan, while Yitong Yang Piao by the Guchong road out toward Jian Province captured Gugong garrison.

units.zh: 文略嘗大遺魏收金，請為其父作佳傳，收論尒朱榮比韋、彭、伊、霍，蓋由是也。
units.en: Wenlüe once paid Wei Shou heavily to glorify his father in print—hence Shou’s likening of Erzhu Rong to Wei Qing, Peng Yue, Yi Yin, and Huo Guang.
units.literal: Wenlüe once gave Wei Shou a large gift of gold and asked him to write a fine biography of his father; that Wei Shou compared Erzhu Rong to Wei Qing, Peng Yue, Yi Yin, and Huo Guang was largely for this reason.

units.zh: 雖然，即墨有安平君，玉壁有韋孝寬，必有以處此。
units.en: Even so, Jimo had Lord Ping of An, and Yubi had Wei Xiaokuan—surely there was a way to meet such a crisis.
units.literal: Even so, at Jimo there was Lord Ping of An, and at Yubi there was Wei Xiaokuan—there must be a way to deal with this.

units.zh: 完顏奴申，字正甫，素蘭之弟也。
units.en: Wanyan Nushen, courtesy name Zhengfu, was the younger brother of Suluan.
units.literal: Wanyan Nushen, styled Zhengfu, was the younger brother of Suluan.

units.zh: 趙彥深嘗謂耀曰：「君研尋《左氏》，豈求服虔、杜預之紕繆邪？」
units.en: Zhao Yanshen once said to Yao, "In studying the Zuo Tradition, are you trying to find errors in Fu Qian and Du Yu?"
units.literal: Zhao Yanshen once said to Yao, "When you study and search the Zuo Tradition, are you seeking the errors of Fu Qian and Du Yu?"

units.zh: 又嘗令左右誦漢書，臥而聽之，至蒯通說韓信曰「相君之背，貴不可言」，寶應蹶然起曰「可謂智士」。
units.en: He once had his attendants read the Book of Han aloud while he listened from his couch. When they reached Kuai Tong's advice to Han Xin—"If you turn your back on Han, your rank will be beyond words"—Baoying sprang up and exclaimed, "A truly wise man!"
units.literal: He once had his attendants recite the Book of Han while he listened lying down. When they came to Kuai Tong telling Han Xin, "When I read your back, your nobility is beyond words," Baoying sprang up and said, "He can truly be called a wise man."

units.zh: 沈炯 虞荔 弟寄 馬樞
units.en: Shen Jiong; Yu Li; younger brother Ji; Ma Shu
units.literal: Shen Jiong; Yu Li; younger brother Ji; Ma Shu

units.zh: 寄正色曰：「覆酈驕韓，未足稱智；
units.en: Ji answered sternly: "A man whose schemes destroyed Li Yiji and filled Han Xin with arrogance hardly deserves to be called wise.
units.literal: Ji said sternly: "Bringing ruin upon Li Yiji and making Han Xin arrogant is not enough to be called wisdom;

units.zh: 隋遣行軍元帥、長史高熲領船艦泝流當之，猛及元遜並降，方泰所部將士離散，乃棄船走。
units.en: Sui sent Gao Jiong with a fleet upstream; Fan and Jiang surrendered, Fangtai's men scattered, and he abandoned his ships and fled.
units.literal: Sui sent the campaign marshal and chief clerk Gao Jiong to lead ships upstream against them; Meng and Yuansun both surrendered, Fangtai's officers and soldiers scattered, and he abandoned his ships and fled.

units.zh: 開皇四年，率諸莫弗賀來謁。五年，悉衆款塞，高祖納之，聽居故地。六年，諸部相攻不止，又與突厥相侵，高祖使使諭解之。別部出伏等違高麗，率眾內附，置於渴奚那頡之北。開皇末，別部四千餘戶違突厥來降，高祖給糧遣還；固辭不去，部落漸眾。遂北徙，逐水草，當遼西正北二百里，依紇臣水而居。紇臣水 按隋書八四、北史九四契丹傳作託紇臣水。東西亙五百里，南北三百里，分為十部，兵多者三千，少者千餘。有征伐，酋帥相與議之，興兵則合符契。突厥沙鉢略可汗遣吐屯潘垤統之，契丹殺吐屯。大業七年，貢方物。
units.en: In Kaihuang year 4 their Mohehe leaders came to court. The next year the entire people tendered submission at the border; Gaozu received them and let them remain on their old lands. In year 6 inter-tribal fighting and clashes with the Turks continued until Gaozu sent mediators. A collateral branch under Chufu broke with Goguryeo, submitted with its followers, and was settled north of Kexina. Late in Kaihuang more than four thousand households left the Turks and surrendered; Gaozu supplied grain for their return, but they refused to go back and their numbers swelled. They moved north along the pastures, two hundred li north of Liaoxi, settling on the Tuo Ge-chen River — so named in Sui Shu 84 and Beishi 94. Their territory ran five hundred li east–west and three hundred li north–south, divided into ten tribes with between one and three thousand fighters each. War was decided in council among the chiefs, who joined tallies to mobilize. Shabolue of the Turks sent Tutun Pan Chi to oversee them, but the Khitan killed Tutun. In Daye year 7 they sent tribute goods.
units.literal: In Kaihuang year 4 they led all the Mohehe to pay court. In year 5 the whole people submitted at the frontier; Emperor Gaozu accepted them and allowed them to dwell in their former lands. In year 6 the tribes attacked one another without cease and also encroached on each other with the Turks; Gaozu sent envoys to admonish and reconcile them. The collateral tribe Chufu and others broke with Goguryeo, led their people to submit inward, and were placed north of Kexina. At the end of Kaihuang a collateral tribe of more than four thousand households broke from the Turks and came to surrender; Gaozu gave grain and sent them back, but they firmly refused to leave and the tribe gradually grew. They then moved north following pasture and water, two hundred li due north of Liaoxi, dwelling along the Ge-chen River — per Sui Shu 84 and Beishi 94 this is the Tuo Ge-chen River. East to west it stretched five hundred li, north to south three hundred li; they were divided into ten tribes, the strongest fielding three thousand warriors, the weakest over a thousand. When there was campaigning the chiefs deliberated together; to raise troops they joined tally-tokens. The Turk Shabolue Khan sent Tutun Pan Chi to command them; the Khitan killed Tutun. In Daye year 7 they presented local products.

units.zh: 周軍三道並出，使其將尉遲迥寇洛陽，楊檦入軹關，權景宣趣懸瓠。
units.en: Northern Zhou armies marched out in three columns, sending the generals Yuchi Jiong against Luoyang, Yang Biao through Zhiguan Pass, and Quan Jingxuan toward Xuanhu.
units.literal: Northern Zhou armies advanced in three columns, sending their generals Yuchi Jiong to raid Luoyang, Yang Biao to enter Zhiguan Pass, and Quan Jingxuan to press toward Xuanhu.

units.zh: 冬十一月甲午，迥等圍洛陽。
units.en: In the eleventh month of winter, on the jiawu day, Yuchi Jiong and his fellows besieged Luoyang.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on the jiawu day, Jiong and the others besieged Luoyang.

units.zh: 壬戌，太師段韶大破尉遲迥等，解洛陽圍。
units.en: On renxu, Grand Preceptor Duan Shao routed Yuchi Jiong and the others, relieving the siege of Luoyang.
units.literal: On the renxu day, Grand Preceptor Duan Shao badly defeated Yuchi Jiong and the others, lifting the siege of Luoyang.
